svg.text: COMPACT QUEENS: FOUR JOURNEYS, WHERE THEY MEET, AND WHERE YOU CAN WATCH FROM
ROUTE OVERLAY ON THE PLAN DIAGRAM (from data). The sightings are COMPUTED (sight.ts): buildings and tall dressing block; 90 m by day.
Routes are the walking network's shortest paths (2C and 4R deliberately avoid the exposed street). Times: the real movement code (tests/compact-walk.ts) where given.
Small red dots: where two players first saw each other away from home in 300 simulated 2-player scavenges. Grey wedge: the best camping spot's view (90 m).
2Q: quick and exposed: along Gnome Ave, up Stain Way past the pub (297 m)
2C: covered: across Gnome into Wood Havoc Lane behind the pub (313 m)
3: F3 to the casino (by the El and NEON FEVER) (259 m)
4: home from SECOND CHANCE by the rear gate (the usual way) (164 m)
4R: round by Stain Way, Rooster Velt and Market St to the FRONT gate (312 m)
